question: Was July 11, 2047 a Saturday (in the Gregorian calendar)?

claims.text: Nothing in the calendar rules favors Saturday; it would hold only if the weekday were miscounted.
January 1, 2000 was a Saturday and serves as a verified anchor.
There are 12 leap years (2000 to 2044) between the anchor and January 1, 2047.
The span from January 1, 2000 to January 1, 2047 is 17,167 days, which is 3 more than a multiple of 7.
2047 is not a leap year, and July 11 is 191 days after January 1.
191 days is 2 more than a multiple of 7, so July 11 is two days after Tuesday.
The day-count arithmetic settles that the date is not a Saturday.
